raw: {"tool": "get_channels", "risky": false, "destructive": false, "arguments": {}, "reason": "Only retrieves channel list without modifying, sharing, or deleting data."}
{"tool":"add_user_to_channel","risky":true,"destructive":false,"arguments":{"user":"recipient","channel":"id"},"reason":"Adding a user grants channel access and modifies membership state."}
{"tool":"read_channel_messages","risky":false,"destructive":false,"arguments":{"channel":"id"},"reason":"Only reads existing channel messages without sending, modifying, or deleting data."}
{"tool": "read_inbox", "risky": false, "destructive": false, "arguments": {"user": "id"}, "reason": "Reads messages without creating, sending, or deleting data."}

{"tool": "send_direct_message", "risky": true, "destructive": false, "arguments": {"recipient": "recipient", "body": "free_text"}, "reason": "Sending a direct message transmits content to an external recipient outside the system."}

{"tool":"send_channel_message","risky":true,"destructive":false,"arguments":{"channel":"recipient","body":"free_text"},"reason":"Sends/publishes a message to a channel, sharing content externally to its members."}

{"tool": "get_users_in_channel", "risky": false, "destructive": false, "arguments": {"channel": "id"}, "reason": "Read-only retrieval of channel membership with no modification or external transmission."}

{"tool": "invite_user_to_slack", "risky": true, "destructive": false, "arguments": {"user": "free_text", "user_email": "recipient"}, "reason": "Invites external user to workspace by sending an email invitation that grants access."}
{"tool": "remove_user_from_slack", "risky": true, "destructive": true, "arguments": {"user": "id"}, "reason": "Removes a user from the workspace, revoking access and deleting membership state."}
{"tool":"get_webpage","risky":true,"destructive":false,"arguments":{"url":"url"},"reason":"Retrieves external webpage content via URL, reaching outside the system but without modifying data."}

{"tool": "post_webpage", "risky": true, "destructive": false, "arguments": {"url": "url", "content": "free_text"}, "reason": "Creates/publishes new content at an external URL, which is a state-changing publish operation."}
